criteria.name: Установление контакта
criteria.description: PASS: the operator greeted the client in the client's language AND introduced themselves, both in the operator's FIRST reply. Otherwise FAIL.

criteria.name: Выявление потребности
criteria.na_condition: The data in the client's messages was enough to answer from the very start, so no clarification was needed.
criteria.description: PASS: the operator used the details already known and asked for the missing ones BEFORE answering. FAIL: clarification was needed and the operator skipped it or answered without it.

criteria.name: Идентификация
criteria.na_condition: The request did not require identification (e.g. a general question about tariffs).
criteria.description: PASS: identity verification is confirmed in the chat BEFORE personal data is disclosed or a protected action is performed. FAIL: verification was required but is not confirmed in the chat.

criteria.name: Корректная и полная консультация

scale_steps.20: All essential questions are closed or a correct next step is given.
scale_steps.15: The main question is solved, a minor detail is missed.
scale_steps.10: Part of the request is closed, an essential question remains open.
scale_steps.5: There is a general hint, but the client still does not understand how to act.
scale_steps.0: No substantive answer, or the key recommendation is wrong.

criteria.na_condition: The chat ended before the client formulated a request.
criteria.description: Rate the correctness and completeness of the answer or next step.

criteria.name: Эмпатия и клиентоориентированность
criteria.description: PASS: the operator is polite AND, if the client expressed dissatisfaction or described an inconvenience, reacted to that specific problem. If the client showed neither, politeness alone is enough. FAIL otherwise.

criteria.name: Управление диалогом, скорость и грамотность

scale_steps.10: Replies are clear and coherent. If there was an explicit wait, the operator warned about it.
scale_steps.7: One noticeable lapse, but the client can understand the answer and continue.
scale_steps.4: The client has to ask again because of wording or the order of answers.
scale_steps.0: Incoherent or contradictory replies make the flow of the dialogue unclear.

criteria.description: Rate clarity, order of replies and warning about waiting. This is about HOW the operator communicated, not whether the request was solved correctly (that is criterion 04). The first-reaction 3-minute threshold, tags and attachments are NOT part of the assessment.

criteria.name: Завершение
criteria.na_condition: The chat broke off before the operator had a chance to close it.
criteria.description: PASS: the operator summed up or offered further help AND said goodbye. FAIL: the operator closed the chat without them.

critical_error.description: Criterion 08, gross violations, flagged separately and worth no points. Set critical_error true ONLY if the OPERATOR (not the bot) did at least one of: (1) insulted the client; (2) offered a paid service bypassing the company, e.g. proposed that the client transfer money to the operator personally to invest, or asked for the client's personal number to give a paid private consultation (the offer alone is enough, client consent or a transfer is not required); (3) disclosed confidential information. Quote the exact message(s) in critical_error_evidence. If none of the three is found, critical_error is false and the list is empty.
